thread:
maria: Heads up — deploybot is proposing an automatic bump for docs-only PRs. Any objections to adding a skiplist for metadata/docs changes?
release-bot: release-bot: detected proposal from @deploy-bot. Current rule: none. Suggested: auto-patch for docs-only.
alex: +1 if we keep the matching strict: only files under `docs/**`, `i18n/**`, or `CHANGELOG.md`. No code/src touch.
jess: product +1 but can we surface these as buildmeta so analytics can filter? e.g. `1.2.3+docs.20260320`
tanner: small concern — docs PRs sometimes sneak tiny behavior changes (README examples that include code). Suggest label-driven flow: label `docs/only` required OR explicit path match. Otherwise fail and require manual bump.
maria: agreed. Proposal: deploybot rule = (paths match docs/** OR i18n/**) OR PR has label `docs/only` -> auto-patch with `+docs` buildmeta and no changelog enforcement. Else normal bump rules (changelog required).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: acknowledged. Will implement pattern: path-glob or label -> tag `patch+docs.<date>`. Default: dry-run mode for 24h in prod before enforcement. :robot_face:
alex: also want to lock auto-bump during our change window: midnight-06:00 UTC. And we need clear rollback/rollforward signals for auto-rollbacks. What metric thresholds?
jess: from product side: be conservative. Docs-only should not affect infra metrics but if it does, prefer manual first. Suggested thresholds: p95 latency increase >= 50% sustained for 3m => page. Errors absolute increase >= 0.5% over baseline for 5m => page and consider rollback.
tanner: ops suggestion: auto-rollback on runaway: error rate > 1% absolute for any 1m window -> immediate rollback. Anything between 0.5% and 1% -> alert + 5min evaluation. Also abort auto-bump if in change window.
maria: summarizing final rules: 1) docs skiplist only via path-glob or `docs/only` label -> patch bump with `+docs` buildmeta; 2) auto-bump disabled 00:00-06:00 UTC; 3) rollback: error >1% for 1m => auto-rollback; p95 >= +50% for 3m or errors >= +0.5% for 5m => page and manual rollback option; 4) deploy-bot will run dry-run for 24h then flip.
release-bot: release-bot: RFC created INF-4012, config PR https://github.com/redwood/releasebot/pull/789 (dry-run enabled).
alex: can we add a tiny semver example in the RFC? snippet: ```# docs-only bump example
# normal: 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4
# docs-only: 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4+docs.20260320```
jess: :thumbsup: please add to the release notes policy doc under "Skiplist / Docs-only" section and note the change-window restriction.
maria: I'll watch dry-run logs tomorrow morning and merge after 24h if no false-positives. Thanks everyone, especially ops for the thresholds.
ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled alert rule changes: created alert `release-auto-rollback` and updated runbook link https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-auto-rollback
